mentions.name: Console Dock
mentions.description: A Chrome extension that adds a floating dev console window directly inside the page, enabling quick debugging sessions without switching or resizing panels, which is useful when working on smaller screens. Still experimental.
mentions.problem: The author often works on smaller screens and dislikes constantly switching or resizing dev tool panels.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on a Chrome extension called Console Dock, which adds a floating dev console window directly inside the page.
